The vault file you picked will replace the one on this phone. Anything entered on the phone since you last copied the file elsewhere will be lost. Save the phone\'s vault first if in doubt.

Investment Tracker %1$s

The same app as on the PC: the backend runs inside this app and the data stays in one encrypted file, portfolio.enc, in the app's private storage.

To use the same data on the PC and the phone, copy the file: Save vault as… here, Open vault file… on the other device (on the PC, put it in the data folder). Keep only one device open at a time.
